designer

I CREATED THE CURVE EDIT BECAUSE I COULD NOT FIND CLOTHES THAT LET MY BODY BREATHE AND MOVE FREELY.

I REFUSED TO BELIEVE THAT BEAUTIFUL HAD TO MEAN UNCOMFORTABLE.

WE ALL DESERVE TO WALK IN TO A ROOM AND MAKE EVERY HEAD TURN, STAND IN THE CENTRE OF THE PHOTOGRAPHS & DANCE UNTIL OUR FEET ACHE.

DRESS FOR THE MOVEMENT YOU WILL TELL STORIES ABOUT AND FEEL LIKE A QUEEN IN IT!

LOTSA LOVE
